sources.title: RAGAs: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation - ACL Anthology
sources.version: EACL 2024 System Demonstrations，正式出版版，pp.150–158；本次讀取作者摘要
sources.excerpt: RAG systems are composed of a retrieval and an LLM based generation module.
sources.inspection_note: 摘要分別列出檢索相關 context、忠實利用 context、生成品質三個評估面向。只支持分站評估的必要性，不證明本專案成效。

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts - ACL Anthology
sources.excerpt: performance can degrade significantly when changing the position of relevant information
sources.inspection_note: 摘要說明改變相關資訊在輸入中的位置會影響受測模型表現。作為輸入改動可能混入其他因素的實證例子，不將其研究數字移植到本專案。

sources.title: Built-in Types — Python 3.13.16 documentation
sources.excerpt: bool is a subclass of int
sources.inspection_note: Boolean Type — bool 明確記載 False 與 True 在許多數值情境分別如整數零與一；這只支持本節的整數求和行為。

sources.title: Built-in Functions — Python 3.13.16 documentation
sources.excerpt: Sums start and the items of an iterable from left to right and returns the total.
sources.inspection_note: sum(iterable, /, start=0) 把 iterable 各元素與預設零起點相加；另實跑本節 generator expression。

sources.title: 6. Expressions — Python 3.13.16 documentation
sources.excerpt: If C is true, x is evaluated and its value is returned
sources.inspection_note: Conditional expressions 定義先求條件，再只求相應分支；Boolean operations 中 not 的真假結果與本節條件篩選一致。
